scope: Simulated PON endpoints and real encrypted MacBook5GHz Wi-Fi. This records an endpoint fixture correction, not physical PON throughput or final firmware acceptance.
fixture_problem: iperf3 --bidir sends upload on55000 and download on55001. The old sink handled only55000. Download ACKs on55001 missed the FE sink and executed TCP ACK/output work inline in NI RX.
change: Install two exact IPv4/TCP/port matches to the same simulated endpoint, using the existing NI NAPI GRO context and ponsink0 RPS8. Keep ap5 RPS0, unchanged ring sizes and thresholds.
separate_unresolved_failures: Original cold boot had484 uplink retransmissions and107 downlink retransmissions with0 L3 drop; later single-direction runs passed without a production code change.

diagnostic_radio: Production PE program unchanged; temporary ARM TX event logging and BA-stop trigger. No performance claim for final ROM acceptance.
